latest_outcome.notes: Reserves manager already has cover in that role. Told the player directly and pointed him towards Quillmere's open trial.

contact_request.message: Hello Antoni. Corinne from Greaveholme Town. I have let Hallowfen know I am getting in touch. I saw on your profile that you are looking for first-team football. Come and train with our reserves and we will both find out whether it is a fit.

messages.body: Thanks Corinne. I can do any evening next week.
Wednesday then, 19:00, same 3G as the development group. Ask for me at the gate.

Antoni, thank you for coming in. You did nothing wrong: tidy, honest, good attitude. Our reserves manager feels he already has two players who do what you do. I would rather tell you that plainly than leave you waiting. Quillmere are running open trial nights and I think their first team would suit you.
